title: A shower this morning, then sun — and it will *feel like 97*
sub:
Low 74°F · 63% chance of rain before noon · light north wind, 5 mph · UV 5
Water 84°F, shoreline waves about 1 foot. Cold front 6 is parked over the Gulf and its heavy rain is staying in the south of the state.
Nothing tropical in the Caribbean. Beach and pool are fine — do errands after the morning shower.
source: AccuWeather · SMN via El Financiero · NHC

title: Pesos buys *two* general seats at Guerra de Chistes tonight
sub:

title: The year Aguakan's contract runs to, and the *Supreme Court* will now review it
sub:
Mexico's Supreme Court agreed to take up two cases over the state Congress's 2023 cancellation of Aguakan's concession extension — one approved 8–1, one 9–0.
Aguakan keeps supplying Playa del Carmen, Cancún, Puerto Morelos and Isla Mujeres under a court suspension from January 2024. A ruling may not come before the first half of 2027.
Nothing changes about your water or your bill today.
source: Luces del Siglo · De Luna Noticias

title: South Playa says the burning smoke now comes *most evenings*
sub:
About 12,000 residents across some 20 fraccionamientos — Bali I, Bali II, La Joya and others — met city officials on Wednesday. Smoke from waste burned near Las Torres has been reported since January 2024 and now arrives around 6 PM.
City hall accepted a 10-point petition and meets the group again Wed 2 Dec at 9 AM in the new Palacio Municipal.
A fire burning now is a 911 call. The city's fire and civil-protection line is in the caption.
